messages:
maya: fyi — after merge r12345 p95 decode on canary jumped ~2x. Noted around 1755500000. Repro on canary VM shows consistent. :eyes:
liam: thx. can you paste the canary link + sample run?
maya: canary: https://canary.redwood/rollouts/12345
maya: local repro command I ran:
```
./bench --model llama-7b --seq 512 --batch 1 --profile --repeat 50
```
maya: baseline p95 ~120ms, after merge p95 ~250ms. nvprof shows extra memcpy in attn hotpath.
julian: I see kernel-selector log lines switching kernels per step: `attn=v1 -> attn=fallback_gemm` around step 20. That toggle explains memcopy churn.
liam: started git bisect between r12310..r12360. first suspect: r12320 (kernel heuristics tweak)
julian: here's a tiny snippet from profiler (reduced):
```
attn_forward  42%  (was 18%)
memcpy_h2d    21%  (new)
kv_lookup     8%
```
sophia: ci-bot flagged perf/regression job 54321 failing p95 by +28% — https://ci/redwood/54321 :warning:
ci-bot: perf/regression job 54321 — FAILED — p95=242ms (baseline 189ms)
liam: bisect found culprit: r12320 touched kernel selector thresholds. Confirmed by reverting locally -> p95 back to ~125ms.
maya: can we do an emergency revert on canary? This is blocking the rollout. :exclamation:
julian: created PR #987 to revert r12320 — https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/987
maya: added canary hold and notified release board. ops-bot scheduled rollback at 03:30 UTC.
ops-bot: rollback scheduled: revert r12320 on canary at 2026-03-18T03:30:00Z :white_check_mark:
liam: after revert canary p95 back to baseline in 30m smoke run. Good.
sophia: opening a small test in perf suite to assert kernel selector doesn't pick fallback for seq<=512.
maya: also adding a unit test to ensure we don't regress for short seq distributions. we'll follow up with postmortem.
liam: next steps: add stricter unit/perf test + merge PR that reworks threshold algorithm, more conservative default, and opt-in aggressive path.
maya: thanks all. moving to #incidents for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
